text: Select: ["chembl_id", "compound_name", "canonical_smiles"]; Source: ["docs", "compound_records", "molecule_dictionary", "compound_structures"]; Join: "docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id AND compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno AND molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno"; Filter: "docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123890' AND compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL"; Sort: ["chembl_id ASC", "compound_name ASC", "canonical_smiles ASC"]; Limit: null
